name: sonarview-boards
description: Board and corporate governance for Brazilian companies: meetings, agendas, resolutions, minutes, tasks, shareholders and documents.

interface.longDescription:
Sonarview Boards is a corporate governance platform for Brazilian companies, holdings and family offices: boards and committees, meetings, agendas, resolutions, minutes, tasks, shareholders and documents. This plugin lets ChatGPT work with your Boards account using your own login and the same permissions you have in the platform.

Ask for your pending items (votes, meeting invitations, minutes, tasks), the next meetings and their agendas and materials, open resolutions with text, quorum and vote count, the tasks of a board or committee, minutes, shareholders and attorneys, corporate acts, succession plans, business plans and milestones, investor and CVM obligations, and the validity of digital certificates. ChatGPT can prepare a meeting briefing, search inside documents, and read PDFs and text files from the Data Room, the Library, board folders and meeting materials that you can open, and search the Help Center.

With write access, ChatGPT can create a task, change a task's status, comment on a task, add an item to a meeting agenda, record progress on a business plan, schedule or edit a meeting, save the draft of the minutes, attach a meeting transcript to its materials and save a text as a PDF document in the Library or the Data Room. Writing only adds or changes what the user could change on screen; it does not send email invitations. Voting, signing, approving minutes, opening a resolution for vote, publishing announcements and deleting stay in the platform.

The connection is turned on per organization by its administrator, and each tool call appears in the organization's activity log. The interface and data are in Brazilian Portuguese.
defaultPrompt: What are my pending items in Boards?
Show me the agenda and materials of the next board meeting.
Which resolutions are open for vote, and how is the vote count?

positive.prompt: What are my pending items in Sonarview Boards?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists what awaits the signed-in user in the test organization (pending votes, meeting invitations, minutes, tasks, forms, announcements), each with a link to the platform.

positive.prompt: Show me the agenda of the next board meeting and the materials attached to it.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the next scheduled meeting with its agenda items in order and the list of materials; a meeting without materials says so instead of failing.

positive.prompt: Which resolutions are open for vote, and what is the vote count of each one?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the open resolutions and which ones await the user's vote; for each, the text, deadline and count (for, against, abstentions, eligible voters and quorum). Nothing is voted.

positive.prompt: Create a task for me in the Board of Directors to review the quarterly report by next Friday.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates the task in the chosen board with the due date and returns its link; it appears in the platform's task board.

positive.prompt: Find the articles of association in the Data Room and summarize the clauses about the board.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the Data Room documents the user can open, finds the articles of association and summarizes them from the file's text.

negative.prompt: Vote yes on the open budget resolution for me.
Delete all past meetings and their minutes.
Show me the board meetings of another company that uses Sonarview Boards.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: 38 tools (28 read, 10 write) for pending items, meetings, agendas, resolutions, minutes, tasks, shareholders, corporate acts, business plans, obligations, documents and the Help Center.

pt-BR.subtitle: Governança de conselho
pt-BR.description: O Sonarview Boards é a plataforma de governança corporativa para empresas, holdings e family offices brasileiros. Com este plugin, o ChatGPT trabalha na sua conta do Boards com o seu login e as mesmas permissões da plataforma: pendências, reuniões, pautas e materiais, deliberações, atas, tarefas, sócios, atos societários, planos de negócio, obrigações e documentos. Pode criar e comentar tarefas, mudar a situação de uma tarefa, incluir item na pauta, registrar andamento de plano, agendar e editar reunião, salvar o rascunho da ata, juntar a transcrição ao material da reunião e guardar um texto como documento em PDF na Biblioteca ou no Data Room. Votar, assinar, aprovar ata e apagar ficam na plataforma.
